chart.note_rule: Use 'Are you' for be verb questions. Use 'Do you' for general verb questions.
chart.note_exception: Short answers: Are you...? → Yes, I am. / No, I'm not.   Do you...? → Yes, I do. / No, I don't.
chart.note_exception_detail: Never say 'Yes, I do.' for 'Are you' questions. Never say 'Yes, I am.' for 'Do you' questions.
